summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K, an English translation of a payment notice for its Series XL Fixed Rate Notes due 2026. The filing announces that on June 22, 2026, the issuer will make the second installment of capital (33% of principal) to noteholders of record as of June 19, 2026. The payment is in ARS at the applicable exchange rate on an outstanding capital of USD 25,600,785.09, with no interest (0% annual nominal rate) and USD 12,609,341.91 in capital being paid. This is a routine debt service notice, not a special situation. There are no extraordinary events, corporate actions, or structural changes; it is a standard payment obligation under the notes' terms.
